ep01.original_name: 外景·保护区·电网墙·夜晚
ep01.description: A towering electrified metal-grid wall stretching into darkness, blue electrical currents crackling along its structure. Heavy rain and wind whip debris horizontally. Cold industrial blue lights cast harsh shadows, with a distant cityscape silhouette beyond. Oppressive, high-contrast blue-black palette.

A large abandoned industrial warehouse with crumbling concrete walls, damaged roof with holes allowing light beams through. Heavy metal doors at the entrance. Dust particles float in visible shafts of light. Shifts from near-total darkness at night to soft golden tones by day. Raw concrete floor, rusted metal fixtures.

ep05.original_name: 外景·优化之城·主街-白天
ep05.description: A pristine futuristic city street bathed in even shadowless white light. Geometric minimalist buildings in white and pale grey line both sides with perfect symmetry.
